subject: Pricing and commit options — per-token tiers, model surcharges, and embeddings
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara@clearview.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearview.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification on per-token tiers and premium model surcharge

Neha — thanks for the quote. A couple of things we need to clarify before we can move to our PO: 

1) The quote shows a per-token baseline and then a separate line item called ‘premium model surcharge’. Can you confirm whether that surcharge is applied on top of the discounted per-token rate or before discounts?

2) For embeddings you priced by 1k vectors; is that counted on an input-only basis or input+output? Our usage is heavy on embedding writes (indexing) and comparatively light on reads.

3) We’re considering a 6-month ramp with a committed minimum. The numbers you provided were helpful, but procurement wants a simple three-tier commit structure (monthly committed tokens) and a clear discount ladder for each tier. Can you send a counter with: 1) standard model rate, 2) premium model rate, and 3) embeddings rate at each commit tier?

Attached: our internal spend forecast (ClearView_Spend_Forecast.xlsx).

Thanks — we’d like to finalize terms by next Wednesday if possible.

—Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Product
ClearView Analytics

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara@clearview.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification on per-token tiers and premium model surcharge

Hi Sara — appreciate the spend file and the clear asks. Summary and proposal below; attaching a concise quote PDF for procurement (Redwood_quote_CV-2026-034.pdf).

Quick answers up front: the premium model surcharge is applied on top of the discounted per-token rate (i.e., discount applies to base model price, surcharge is multiplicative on the post-discount unit). Embeddings are charged per 1k vectors produced (output only). Indexing/writes incur the same per-vector charge; reads/search vectors are not charged unless you request on-the-fly generation.

Proposed commit tiers (monthly committed tokens) — per-token unit examples and net effective rates at each tier: 
- Tier A: 0–50M tokens/month (no commit) — Standard model: $0.0006/token; Premium models: +30% surcharge (effective $0.00078/token); Chat (system+user+assistant tokens billed same as generation). Embeddings: $0.006 per 1k vectors.
- Tier B: 50–250M tokens/month (committed) — 12% discount off base standard rate (net $0.000528/token). Premium surcharge: +25% on post-discount (net $0.00066/token). Embeddings: $0.0052 per 1k vectors.
- Tier C: >250M tokens/month (committed, annualized pricing available) — 22% discount off base standard rate (net $0.000468/token). Premium surcharge: +20% on post-discount (net $0.000562/token). Embeddings: $0.0043 per 1k vectors.

Other notes and optional add-ons: 
- We can offer an additional 3% discount for a 12-month firm commitment and an invoice-in-advance model.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) can be bundled if you need predictable latency; pricing is separate and we can include a credit back against committed consumption.
- We bill tokens per our standard counting (input + output tokens for generation; embeddings only charge on vectors produced) and provide daily usage reports.

Next steps / mutual action plan: 
1) If these ranges look reasonable, procurement to confirm which tier and whether you want a 6-month ramp or 12-month firm commit.
2) We will issue a finalized PDF quote and redline-friendly order form.
3) Engineering to confirm SLOs for your peak sequence lengths (Aditya, can you confirm the latency SLO on multi-turn chat at 3k seq?).
4) Legal/Finance to review PO terms (Rishi/Laura).

Attaching the quote and a short per-tier breakdown (inlined in attachment). Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk procurement through the math.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0112

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@ridhi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Clarification on per-token tiers and premium model surcharge — internal

Aditya / Rishi — forwarding ClearView’s ask. Key items they want: simple three-tier commit, explicit premium surcharge treatment, and embeddings unit clarity. My proposed public-facing numbers are in the quote attachment. 

Questions for you: 
- Aditya: can we guarantee the latency SLO at 3k seq for the premium model if they choose Tier C with burst? Any constraints on cache/batching that would materially affect cost?
- Rishi: procurement may push for a deeper discount at Tier B if they sign a 6-month committed ramp and submit PO up front. Do we have flexibility to offer an additional one-time onboarding credit (e.g., $25k) without C-level signoff?

Also flagging: they asked about treatment of embeddings reads vs writes — per our product notes embeddings are charged on vector output. If they insist on write-only charging we can consider a small credit; curious if Legal needs to note that in the order form.

Thanks — Neha

—Aditya replied:

"Neha — 3k seq on premium model: we can meet 95th percentile latency SLOs under Tier C reserved capacity assumptions. For committed cloud-hosted tiers without dedicated capacity, batching may increase tail latency; we should call that out. I’ll add a short SLO appendix to the quote.

—Aditya"

—Rishi replied:

"We can absorb a modest onboarding credit (up to $20k) at manager approval. Anything beyond that needs director signoff. I'll prepare a PO-friendly term sheet with standard redlines.

—Rishi"

From: Marco Rossi <marco@clearview.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sara Khan <sara@clearview.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearview.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and commit options — per-token tiers, model surcharges, and embeddings

Neha / team — thanks for the transparent breakdown. Procurement has reviewed the PDF quote. We can proceed with the following ask before we issue a PO: 

1) Tier B commit (target 100M tokens/month average over 6 months) with a 6-month ramp schedule spelled out in the order form.
2) Reduce the premium model surcharge to 20% on post-discount for the 6-month ramp only (we can revert to quoted surcharge after ramp).
3) Request a one-time $20k onboarding credit applied at invoice #1.

If you agree, procurement will issue a PO for the first month and we will execute DocuSign for the order form. Please confirm and resend a final quote + DocuSign link.

Thanks — Marco
Marco Rossi
CFO
ClearView Analytics
